description: One clean mesh per public (episode, object) pair, built only from that episode's own observed points with C0b's scan-free constants and picked within the episode (C0b PREREG s5 with ALL = own points). For the score session's perception re-track test (perc2 with these meshes as templates). Not scored here.
frame: object frame of the library_v3-seeded sweep track, as fitted (no alignment); same frame as meshes/library_v3
gt_free: inputs: sweep tracks, C0b pass-B observed points (FoundationStereo depth), C0b thickness/sigma/markers, t0_C0b; never scans, mocap, parquet poses, *_align or scan-derived constants

e0_frame_gate.note: REPORT ONLY. PUBOWN's rule (C0b s5) has no frame gate and its picks are unchanged. The E0 PREREG s4 identity frame gate (3x the C0 public mesh value vs library_v3; E0 inputs/thresholds.json, fixed before PUBOWN) is applied here as a reading, and alt_e0_gated is C0b s5 re-applied to the candidates that also pass it (library_v3 when none does). beige_cup has no E0 threshold: not gated.
